fusions.name: Downhill Ram
fusions.desc: A running ram from up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Headlong Butt
fusions.desc: A hard blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stiff Neck
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Planted Feet
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
